reviewer: collaboration_benchmark subagent, independent read-only follow-up review
scope: Batch accounting retention, assignment denominator, native activity normalization and the five regression tests; no model quality adjudication.
verified_fixes: Every assignment exists before execution; current assignment is durably marked started before entering runner.run_case.

Raw runner output is saved before normalization. Normalization exceptions become audit_failure while retaining raw usage, elapsed time and evidence location; later assignments remain not_started in the same denominator.
Corrupt event JSON is recorded as an audit error without discarding independently complete request usage and estimated cost. Missing request terminal usage does not become a free request.

Repeated child activations retain all activity_spans. This single-activation profile deliberately omits start/end for multi-span children instead of selecting the first interval or inventing an envelope.

verified now requires the expected child count, complete single spans, full-packet evidence and observed spawn/wait/close tool names; missing boundaries remain unknown. Identity/packet verification is separate.

validation.method: AST-loaded batch functions with a synthetic two-assignment manifest, mocked runner and normalization failure; no real runner request
assertions: Mock runner observes persisted statuses [started, not_started].
Mock normalize observes batch-raw-result.json exactly equal to returned raw result before it raises.
After failure, statuses are [audit_failure, not_started], known raw usage is retained, unknown cost remains null, and batch stops with exit code 1.

limits: Reviewed the administrative code and synthetic tests only; did not verify actual provider invoices, live child activity or model task quality.
Complete aggregate usage and wall_seconds remain dependent on the upstream runner's definitions. This review does not independently certify those upstream measurements.
The native timing review applies to the documented single-activation profile and normal runtime event schema; multi-activation timing correctly remains unverified.
